faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II — Create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
III — Knights you control get +2/+1 until end of turn.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — All creature cards you own with mana value 2 or less perpetually get +1/+0.
II — Seek a creature card with mana value 2 or less and put it onto the battlefield.
III — Creatures you control with mana value 2 or less gain flying until end of turn.

I — This Saga gains "{T}: Add {U}."
II — This Saga gains "{U}, {T}: Conjure a card named Jace's Sentinel onto the battlefield."
III — Empower Jace 3.

faces.f: The Theorist is very careful with which students he selects to assist him, and even more careful about what he allows them to change.

n: Rahilda, Wanted Cutthroat // Rahilda, Feral Outlaw
Albiorix, Goose Tyrant // Wild Goose Chase

faces.chapters:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Seek a card with mana value less than the number of cards in your hand.
II — Seek a card with mana value greater than the number of cards in your hand.
III — Count the number of cards in your hand. You may cast a spell with mana value equal to that number from your hand without paying its mana cost.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Victory of the Pyrohammer deals 4 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. Victory of the Pyrohammer gains "Damage isn't removed from creatures during cleanup steps."
II, III — Victory of the Pyrohammer deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.

(As this Saga enters and after your draw step add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I — Conjure a card named Gilded Goose onto the battlefield.
II, III — You may tap an untapped Bird you control and sacrifice an artifact. If you do, conjure a card named Golden Egg onto the battlefield.
